name: Downloadable product
description: Allow to define digital goods for purchase.
project_description: Downloadable product is an Arch submodule that turns a product type into a seller of digital goods. Marking a product type "Downloadable" adds a multi-value private-scheme file field (product_file) to it; customers who have a completed order containing the product can then download the attached files from a signed, per-user URL. A "My files" tab on the user page (/user/{user}/downloads) lists every purchased file with a download link.
